content: service method ResetMachine [SWS_SM_91100] Upstream: RS_SM_00001 , RS_SM_00004 ResetMachine () Requests a reset of the machine. Before the reset is performed all information within the machine shall be persisted. Request will be rejected when RequestUpdateSession was not called successfully before.
